items.rationale: Sections 2.3.3 and 4.2.2 cover lightning-induced surge damage to fixed climate-control equipment if the fire group is in force; the description does not confirm the surge source or schedule. If covered, §§7.1.9–7.1.10 allow one like-for-like replacement at €1,413, with no kitchen-location exclusion.
Under §§7.1.1(b) and 7.1.11, fitting the insured replacement follows the unit's coverage: 1 × €480. Any unrelated wiring check bundled into this line must be separated under §9.5.

Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7 allow €61 for one equivalent console if the original was damaged or could not be reused in the covered repair. The description establishes that a console was used, but not that it needed replacement.
Under §7.1.11, necessary freight for an insured replacement is payable at 1 × €43; any share attributable to non-covered equipment must be separated.
